text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Ah... how tragic. Everyone is awestruck by 
me, refusing a duel at the Satsuki Sho! 
And yet—the Goddess smiled upon me.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The passerby, Admire Vega—or rather, the 
passionate fan who also attended the 
year-end party! Apparently, she's running 
in the Satsuki Sho too.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
This is destiny! And thus, the stage was 
set!
